summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Thrivent Small Cap Value ETF (TSCV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund seeks long-term capital growth by actively managing a portfolio of undervalued US small-cap companies. The fund uses fundamental analysis to select equity securities. TSCV was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by Thrivent.

holdings.infoBox: TSCV is an equity ETF with a total of 58 individual holdings. The top holdings are Ssc Government Mm Gvmxx stock at 3.53%, UMB Financial at 2.82%, Valley National Bancorp at 2.49%, Ashland at 2.44%, and Old National Bancorp at 2.43%.
